_comment: pi-coding-agent MCP config — install at ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json. Same shape as Claude Code's mcpServers entry, with two pi-only extras: `directTools` (allowlist that lets the agent call these tools directly without going through the orchestrator) and the broader ~/.pi/agent/ tree (settings.json, models.json, extensions/). Edit the command path + grounder URL for your host.
